Heyo everyone it’s me FC! I’m back after a short break. Thank you all for your patience! I didn’t make the 50 bots so I could enjoy my break but I did come up with juicy ideas for bots in the future (tomorrow or later today)
A lot has happened, not all bad, mostly good. I learned how to make cookies and snowballs, my grandma used to make them for me all the time when I was younger-she’s my biological grandma but she adopted me as her grandson. I also have a Korean grandma who insists I go to church with her every weekend. 
It’s funny because I complain about being lonely but I tend to meet some of the most interesting people at random. Met and chatted with a few followers, and I applied to a few places to work, in desperate need of money but it’s chill for now. I’m much happier now, been doing a lot to keep myself busy lol anyways enough about me, I hope you all have been doing good and if not I hope I can make you feel better with the bots I’m dropping! Enough yapping and yammering, enjoy Eli!

P.s. to save some time I stopped using the overly complicated character cards, the bots are more unique and raw if I just use the simplified card layouts.
